name: SaveLocker
author: SkorcherX
//flags: debug is the RELOAD OPT-IN, not a dev switch: loader.py refuses to re-load a plugin whose files changed unless 'debug' is in flags ('Plugin X is already loaded and has requested to not be re-loaded'). It is the flag's only effect anywhere in the loader, and store plugins ship with it. Without it, updating the files on disk does nothing until Decky restarts. NOT 'root' — see README.

publish.description: Sets the Steam launch options SaveLocker needs, so a Deck syncs saves without pasting a command into every game.
